summary: Bound assistant source-card construction to requested collection pages

replay.detail: No claim replay or authoritative data rewrite. Attention and roster readers reuse existing in-memory publications.

schema.detail: Adds mission_runs_collection_latest_index and mission_runs_collection_live_index through idempotent schema-on-open installation, including existing stores. Both are additive derived indexes; authoritative rows, schema version and replicated projections are unchanged.

rules.detail: No admission, checkpoint, retention or authority rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Assistant collection reads require ready native publications rather than rebuilding whole collections. Mission continuations expire with page-cursor-expired after changed mission inputs or more than 512 intervening claims instead of silently skipping missions whose sort keys moved. Read-authorization receipts alone do not invalidate continuations. Cursor disclosure, grant and policy isolation remain enforced.

downtime.detail: The first open builds two mission-run indexes synchronously before serving. Installation cost depends on local mission-run history and has not been independently timed on a large live store; subsequent opens reuse the indexes.

manual.detail: No manual SQL, configuration or data conversion is required.

recovery.detail: Older binaries still open the store and ignore the additional indexes, which SQLite continues maintaining. Ordinary binary rollback needs no conversion; volatile publications are rebuilt normally.
